prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a small, modern black portable speaker resting on a glossy, dark granite countertop. The speaker is rectangular with rounded edges, featuring a mesh grille and subtle indicator lights—one glowing blue, another white—suggesting it is powered on and in use. A white charging cable is plugged into the side, trailing out of frame. Behind the speaker, a large open book with clean, white pages and printed text is propped up, slightly out of focus, adding a sense of domesticity and quiet activity. The lighting is soft and natural, with gentle highlights reflecting off the polished surface of the counter, creating a calm, intimate atmosphere. The composition is tight and focused, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background, drawing attention to the speaker as the central subject. The overall color palette is muted and neutral, dominated by blacks, whites, and subtle reflections, evoking a modern, minimalist aesthetic.
